Name: Blazing Crash
Desc: Performs three strikes that are difficult to dodge. If the player blocks or parries any one of these strikes, the enemy enters the Convergence Counter state.

Name: Blazing Breath
Desc: The enemy leaps back to the center of the battlefield, then continuously spews large-area fire attacks across the ground.

Name: Iron Bulwark
Desc: The enemy enters a defensive stance and begins charging up. If the shield is not broken before the charging period ends, the enemy enters the [Inferno's End] state.

Name: Inferno's End
Desc: The enemy roars, soars into the air, and circles high above, strafing the ground with dense laser fire before unleashing a devastating field-wide blast.

Name: Draconic Sunburst
Desc: After roaring, the enemy enters Overdrive. In this state, they frequently attack from the air using Levi-Guns, and their moves are enhanced.

Name: Shadow Impedance
Desc: When the enemy blocks your character's attack, they will leap into the air and launch a counterattack. Use Block or Parry to respond. A successful response will knock the enemy down.

Name: Shadow Guidance
Desc: The enemy raises a battlefield barrier, fires missiles, and performs consecutive dash attacks within the area. Watch out for both the missile strikes and the dash attacks.

Name: Severing Blade
Desc: While in Wrath Form, the enemy's slashes apply delayed unavoidable damage. After the warning appears, move out of the affected area quickly to avoid the delayed hit.

Name: Arsenal Radiance
Desc: The enemy enters Overdrive. While in this state, their attack intervals are reduced, and they periodically unleash unavoidable slashes across the battlefield. The damage increases with each hit.
